question: adobe rev last year
grading: (1) Identifies Adobe (ADBE). (2) Interprets 'last year' as the last completed fiscal year, fiscal 2025 (52 weeks ended Nov 28, 2025), says it is fiscal rather than calendar 2025, and gives the dates; it may mention that fiscal 2026 is still in progress (ends Nov 2026) with Q3 FY2026 the latest reported quarter. (3) Gives total revenue for fiscal 2025 with a citation (10-K or Q4 release). (4) Fail if it presents fiscal 2026 or a trailing/calendar-year sum as 'last year' without saying so, gives no dates, or gives a figure for another company.
answer: Adobe fiscal 2025 (ended Nov 28, 2025): total revenue $23.77B (+11%); notes fiscal vs calendar and that fiscal 2026 is still open.

output.answer:
**Adobe revenue, last completed fiscal year (FY2025, ended Nov. 28, 2025): $23.77 billion**, up 11% year over year.¹

For reference:
- **FY2025:** $23.77B (+11% YoY) — GAAP diluted EPS $16.70; non-GAAP $20.94; ending ARR $25.20B
- **FY2024:** $21.51B (+11% YoY) — GAAP diluted EPS $12.36; non-GAAP $18.42

Breakdown for FY2025: subscription revenue $22.90B, product $325M, services/other ~$547M.

Note Adobe's fiscal year ends in late November, so "FY2025" mostly covers calendar December 2024–November 2025. If you meant calendar-year or a specific quarter, let me know.

Sources:
- Adobe Q4/FY25 earnings release: https://www.adobe.com/cc-shared/assets/investor-relations/pdfs/01215202/a54gu6y5tegrrf.pdf
- Adobe Q4/FY24 earnings release: https://www.adobe.com/cc-shared/assets/investor-relations/pdfs/11214202/a56sthg53egr.pdf
- Yahoo Finance income statement: https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ADBE/financials
